title: All Hell Breaks Lose When Father Loses His Temper
description:
On November 5th, 2022. Police responded to a hostile scene involving two parents, who had been in a heated argument about the custody of their child. The man said he wanted to see his child but the mother would not let him & and as she was about to pull out of the driveway the man threw a bicycle at the windshield which shattered on the inside leaving glass shards exposed to the woman & the child (who was in the front seat).
